evidence.sentence: Chemring Countermeasures Limited designs and manufactures RF and IR countermeasures that are devised to protect air and naval platforms from missile threats.
Chemring Countermeasures Ltd, High Post, Salisbury, Wiltshire, SP4 6AS
Located on the edge of Salisbury Plain and about eight miles from the cathedral city, we employ 400 people with a wide variety of skills and capabilities.

note: The entity is Chemring Countermeasures Ltd, a UK subsidiary of Chemring Group PLC. chemring.co.uk redirects to the group site chemring.com, so the record uses the unit's own contact domain (info@chemringcm.com on the same page). The 400 figure is the unit's own headcount, not the group's.
